newsitem.title: USA: Nikko Securities U.S. unit hires PaineWebber exec.
newsitem.headline: Nikko Securities U.S. unit hires PaineWebber exec.

text.p: Nikko Securities Co International Inc said it named Timothy Cronin co-president and co-chief executive.
Nikko said Cronin last served as PaineWebber Group Inc's executive vice president of global risk and a member of the firm's board.

Nikko Securities Co Internationa, a U.S. unit of Japan's Nikko Securities Co Ltd, said Cronin will share the titles with Toshio Yokoyama. Both will also will serve as co-president and co-CEO of Nikko Americas Holding Co Inc, the holding company for Nikko Securities International.
